the ecology of stress.
how the social environment affects the ecology and evolution of stress physiology in animals.
the effects of the social and physical environments on the physiology, behavior, and ecology of animals.

social environment is an important determinant of health, but the mechanisms by which social environment impacts health are not well understood.
